subject: Order Form: payment orchestration, invoice splits & tax allocation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@vectorscale.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order Form: payment orchestration, invoice splits & tax allocation

Alex — thanks again for the productive call yesterday. I reviewed the Order Form redlines your team sent (attached) and want to confirm a couple of operational items so we can get to signature without back-and-forth: 

1) Invoice cadence and split: You proposed two invoices (50% upfront on countersign, 50% at delivery). Finance needs the exact invoice milestones for the PO and for our revenue recognition team. Can you confirm: (a) invoice 1 = countersign date, (b) invoice 2 = go-live / first production month start? If VectorScale needs different touchpoints (e.g., quarterly tranches), tell us the desired dates.

2) Net terms / approvals: Your redline mentions Net 45. Our standard is Net 30; Laura from finance is cc'd to approve a Net 45 exception if required. Please indicate who on your side signs off on extended terms so we can route approvals.

3) Taxes & VAT: We need your tax residency evidence (VAT ID or W-9) to determine whether Redwood should issue invoices with VAT applied or not. If VectorScale is VAT-registered, please send VAT registration number and the country of registration. If US entity please send W-9.

4) PO format: If you will issue a PO, please attach the PO template (we saw a blank one in the redline package). Marissa, looping you for any legal concerns about the wording around invoicing and tax language.

I've attached the redline PDF your team shared and highlighted the commercial clauses that require operational details. Once we confirm the milestones and tax evidence, I can prepare the final countersigned Order Form and a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0169
(attachment: OrderForm_VS_Redlines_20260625.pdf)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@vectorscale.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@vectorscale.com
Date: 2026-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: payment orchestration, invoice splits & tax allocation

Ben — thanks for the recap. Quick answers from procurement below; we'll follow up with the PO attached by end of day Monday.

1) Invoice cadence: We prefer three tranches to align with internal budget windows: 40% on countersign, 30% at 90 days, 30% at 180 days. If Redwood requires a two-invoice flow, we can accept 50/50 but would need clear internal approvals.

2) Net terms: Procurement will sign for Net 45. Finance (cc'd) will need to complete the supplier setup but Net 45 is acceptable.

3) Taxes: VectorScale is US-headquartered but has EU operations. We'll upload a W-9 and EU VAT registration for the EU entity. Note: for EU billing, we ask that Redwood invoice the EU legal entity directly to avoid cross-border VAT complications. 

Attaching our PO template for your ops team. If there are specific fields Redwood needs populated (tax codes, remit-to), call that out and procurement will populate.

Alex

--
(attachment: VectorScale_PO_Template.docx)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, alex.turner@vectorscale.com
Date: 2026-06-28T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: payment orchestration, invoice splits & tax allocation

Ben / Alex — thanks for the details. A few operational items from finance: 

- Net 45: acceptable for this deal on condition we receive the PO and an approved procurement contact for accounts payable. Please confirm the full remit address and the legal entity that will be on the invoice (VectorScale Inc. vs VectorScale EU Ltd). We need that to determine tax treatment.

- Tranche-based invoicing: we can support 3-tranche invoicing (40/30/30), but revenue recognition requires milestone dates. Alex — can you propose exact dates (e.g., countersign = 2026-07-02, tranche 2 = 2026-10-02, tranche 3 = 2027-01-02) or confirm fiscal/Q dates you want?

- PO matching: our AP system does 2-way match; if you include the PO number on each invoice we will process without delay. If VectorScale requires other fields (cost center, project code), include them in the PO.

Also, for EU entity invoicing, we need the VAT ID and legal entity name to route the invoice to our EU billing team.

I'll provision a Net 45 approval ticket internally once Ben confirms PO + remit details.

Laura
Director, Revenue Operations
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: alex.turner@vectorscale.com
Date: 2026-06-29T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: payment orchestration, invoice splits & tax allocation

Ben / Laura — from legal side a couple of small asks to avoid contract churn after signature: 

- Invoice wording: we should include an invoice address block and a single-line statement in the Order Form that Redwood may split billing per the agreed milestones. That avoids later disputes if VectorScale's PO references different schedules.

- Taxes clause: add a parenthetical that VectorScale is responsible for any withholding taxes and that Redwood will invoice exclusive of VAT unless a VAT number is provided for the billed entity. This mirrors our standard playbook.

- Change of legal entity: if VectorScale intends to have the EU subsidiary sign/receive invoices, request that an addendum be executed rather than a substituted invoice flow (keeps audit trail clean).

I redlined proposed language and uploaded a short PDF with comments. If VectorScale confirms which legal entity will be billed, we can insert the exact wording and finalize.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Commercial
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

(attachment: OrderForm_VS_Redlines_20260625.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@vectorscale.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, procurement@vectorscale.com
Date: 2026-06-30T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: payment orchestration, invoice splits & tax allocation

Alex — thanks, this is helpful. Confirming next steps so we can close this week: 

1) VectorScale to upload signed PO (or complete PO template) by Monday 2026-07-05 with remit address and PO number. 
2) VectorScale to provide W-9 for US entity and VAT ID for EU entity by Monday. If EU entity will be billed, confirm the legal name and we will prepare an addendum. 
3) Redwood to accept 3-tranche 40/30/30 per milestone dates — Ben will draft proposed milestone dates for VectorScale to confirm. 
4) Laura to open Net 45 approval ticket on receipt of PO; Marissa to pull final invoice/tax language into the Order Form. 

If you confirm the PO upload and the remit/legal entity details, I will generate the DocuSign envelope and route for countersignature. Target to have countersign by 2026-07-09.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0169
